=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21560,24376-24392,32262-32276 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: close_linked_pr passes "0" as the stall clock to _stall_pr_ai_hold_reason, which disables the rc-1 backstop (`stall_minutes > 2*max`, 27184) and the rc-2 backstop (`stall_minutes > 0`, 27186). The managed and standalone close_and_reissue main-close arms (24384 / 32271) do not check CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS. After _stall_reissue_green_pr_guard lets the hold lapse using the real stall clock, close_linked_pr holds the PR again and leaves it open, and the arms still close the source issue with ai:closed.
  WHY: The replacement issue is already created at 24376 / 32262, so the old implementation PR is left orphaned and open next to a duplicate replacement issue, and it can still merge later. This breaks the #9892 bounded-wait goal. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. The tests test_close_linked_pr_keeps_lease_waiting_pr_open and test_stall_hold_rechecks_pass_the_stall_clock lock in the "0" call. Suggested fixes: an optional stall-clock argument for close_linked_pr, defaulting to "0", that receives ${stall_minutes} / ${elapsed_minutes}, and/or a CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS check after 24384 and 32271.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21536-21560,24524-24531,32364-32379 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Because close_linked_pr passes "0", the lease hold inside it never lapses when the label age is unreadable. rc-1 needs 0 > 2*max. rc-2 needs a clock above 0 plus updated_at, and the --jq projection at 21537 drops updated_at. The exhausted close-outs therefore log STALL_SKIP ... source=close_linked_pr and return 1 / continue on every tick.
  WHY: recover_stalled_issue (32843-32850) and the skip arm's re-check (24432) pass the real stall clock, so their holds lapse and execution reaches the close-out. There the PR is held again on every tick, and the issue is never closed or escalated to ai:needs-human. That is the "leftover label parks an issue forever" outcome the backstops were added to prevent. Reviewers who stated a severity rated it MAJOR; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite stated none.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5370,5384-5390 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _stall_judge_pick_linked_pr filters for the lowest-numbered implementation PR only after fetching all candidates, so an implementation PR that falls past the 20-candidate cap is never seen.
  WHY: The stall judge can fall back to the last cross-reference and run close_and_reissue on the wrong PR, or miss the right one. The reviewer stated no severity, so medium is a default assigned here.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5370-5395 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: On the judge path, _stall_judge_pick_linked_pr can fetch up to 20 full pulls/<n> payloads (_fetch_pr_json) per stalled issue per tick. The stated API budget is "at most two gh pr list calls".
  WHY: This raises orchestrator latency and uses up API quota quickly when many issues are stalled. The reviewer stated no severity, so medium is a default assigned here.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25562 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _stall_pr_ai_hold_reason returns rc 2, which is not cached, for label-age read errors, so a persistent read error re-evaluates the hold on every tick.
  WHY: This can cause excessive API calls and unnecessarily long holds while the label age stays unreadable. The reviewer stated no severity, so medium is a default assigned here.
- tests/test_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard.py:518-545 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In test_close_linked_pr_keeps_lease_waiting_pr_open, the stub for _stall_merge_lease_label_age_minutes (line 530) always returns a numeric age, so the rc-1 and rc-2 paths under the "0" stall clock are never exercised.
  WHY: The orphan-PR invariant is not pinned by any test, so a regression in the close_linked_pr stall clock would not be caught. The reviewer rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:close_linked_pr, line 21560: pr_hold_reason="$(_stall_pr_ai_hold_reason "${pr_meta_json}" "0")". Called by the managed close_and_reissue arm at line 24384 and the standalone arm at line 32271. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With "0", the fallback for a label age that cannot be read never fires, because rc 1 needs `stall_minutes > 2*max`. _stall_reissue_green_pr_guard gets the real clock (23573, 31553), so its hold lapses and close_and_reissue goes ahead. close_linked_pr then holds the PR again and leaves it open, and neither caller checks CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS.
  WHY: The replacement issue is already created (24376 / 32262), and the source issue is closed with ai:closed while the old PR stays open and orphaned. Work is duplicated and the stale PR can still merge. Suggested fix: an optional stall-clock argument that defaults to "0", or a CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS check after 24384 and 32271.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:The exhausted close-out at lines 24524-24531 ... The standalone version at 32364-32369 ... line 21560 ("0") ... The --jq projection at line 21537 carries number and labels but no updated_at. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: With "0", the hold inside close_linked_pr has no upper bound for either rc 1 or rc 2, because the projection drops updated_at. The earlier checks (32844-32847, 24432) use the real clock and lapse, so execution reaches the close-out, where the PR is held again.
  WHY: Every tick logs STALL_SKIP ... source=close_linked_pr and returns 1 without counting an attempt, so the issue stays parked indefinitely, which README and the changelog say cannot happen.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:close_and_reissue main close, right after close_linked_pr at lines 24384 and 32271 | HARDENING | risk=3
  PROBLEM: These are the only callers that do not check CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS (the others are 24256, 24526, 32164 and 32365).
  WHY: Suggested fix: emit a ::warning:: or STALL_SKIP line naming the orphaned PR (3-4 lines per site).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: The stall judge may fall back to the last cross-reference and run close_and_reissue on the wrong PR.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 21560; managed main close at lines 24384 (no CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS check between 24384 and 24391); standalone main close at lines 32271 (no check between 32271 and 32276) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: "0" disables both backstops (27184, 27186). The sites at 24254, 24524, 32163 and 32364 check CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS, but 24384 and 32271 do not. The guard at 23568 / 31549 can allow the reissue through its own backstop, and then close_linked_pr refuses to close the PR, which leaves it orphaned.
  WHY: The replacement issue is created (24376 / 32262) and the source issue is closed (24391 / 32276) while the implementation PR stays open, which undermines the #9892 bounded-wait goal.
- tests/test_stall_reissue_green_pr_guard.py:test `test_close_linked_pr_keeps_lease_waiting_pr_open` at lines 518-545; stub at line 530 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stub always returns a numeric age, so rc 1 and rc 2 under "0" are never exercised. test_stall_hold_rechecks_pass_the_stall_clock does not assert that a non-zero clock is passed.
  WHY: A regression would go uncaught, and the orphan-PR scenario could land silently in production.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 21560, lines 27183-27192, lines 24384/24391 and 32271/32276 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: "0" fails both the rc-1 check (27184) and the rc-2 check (27186). The comment at 21554-21559 says the hold "lapses only on the label's own readable age", which contradicts the #9892 bounded-wait spec. The hold becomes permanent inside close_linked_pr.
  WHY: Inside close_and_reissue the source issue is closed and the replacement is created, while the held PR stays open with no later path that closes it.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:After `close_linked_pr` at line 24384 and at line 32271 | HARDENING | risk=3
  PROBLEM: The close_and_reissue arms do not abort when the PR is held.
  WHY: Suggested fix: add the CLOSE_LINKED_PR_HELD_PRS abort block with STALL_SKIP, close_and_reissue_skipped_pr_ai_hold and return 1, and handle the replacement issue that was already created (6-10 lines per site).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 21560, in the comment block 21554-21559 | HARDENING | risk=3
  PROBLEM: The comment justifies "0" while that value silently disables the #9892 backstops.
  WHY: Suggested fix: use `"${_CLP_STALL_MINUTES:-0}"` with the reissue callers passing stall_minutes / elapsed_minutes, or document the trade-off and add the abort (2-4 lines plus the abort blocks).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
